title: Alike's Additions
description: Bunch of mods that enhance vanilla Minecraft, without adding new stuff.
body:
**A bunch of mods that enhance vanilla Minecraft, without adding new stuff.**

Includes _QOL mods, Resource packs, Shaders, Creative building tools, ect._

**Updating soon to 26.1, i'm just waiting for the mods to update.**

I plan to **update this constantly with new minecraft versions**, and **maybe add some new mods** along the way.

Made originally for myself to use, but decided to upload it beacuse why not!

### Mods and functionality:
**Entity Model Features, Entity Texture Features** - Allows resource packs to change the appearance of mobs. Required for Fresh Animations to work properly.

**AmbientSounds** - Adds ambient sounds depending on the location.

**AppleSkin** - Shows how much a food will heal, and shows the saturation bar.

**Axiom** - Helpful for building in creative. Adds tools that make building feel like using professional software.

**Borderless Fullscreen** - Replaces the exclusive fullscreen of the game to be borderless instead. Makes alt + tabbing much easier.

**Continuity** - Adds connected textures for glass, bookshelf, ect.

**Controlify** - Makes the game fully playable with a gamepad.

**Cool Rain** - Adds rain sounds corresponding to what material rain falls on.

**Explosive Enhancement** - Revamps how explosions look.

**Freecam** - Adds freecam to the game. Useful for building.

**Hold My Items** - Adds cool animations and models to holding items.

**Immersive Hotbar** - Adds cool animations to the hotbar.

**Iris Shaders** - Adds shaders to the game.

**Litematica** - Save and load blueprints, with many useful features.

**Locator Heads** - Highly customizable locator bars.

**Mod Menu** - Access mods and their configs in-game.

**Paper Doll** - Adds a bedrock like preview of your avatar to the corner of the screen.

**Particle Interactions** - Adds cool particles when breaking or placing blocks.

**Particle Rain** - Revamps how rain and snow looks.

**Particular, Visuality** - Adds ect. particles to certain actions.

**Pick Up Notifier** - Displays what blocks or items you've picked up.

**Presence Footsteps** - Revamps footstep sounds.

**Reimagined Intro** - Overhauls the main menu.

**ReplayMod** - Allows you to save replays of your worlds which you can later play back.

**Shulker Box Tooltip** - Displays what items are in a shulker box.

**Skin Overrides** - Allows you to locally change the skin of players. Useful in offline servers where skins don't display properly.

**Smooth Gui** - Adds a little animation to opening GUIs.

**Smooth Scrolling** - Makes scrolling in GUIs and hotbar a lot smoother.

**Smooth Swapping** - Adds animations to shift clicking items to GUIs.

**uku's Armor HUD** - Displays armor next to the hotbar.

**Wakes** - Adds waves to the water that react to entities.

**WI Zoom** - Gives you the ability to zoom.

**Ferritecore, ImmediatelyFast, Lithium, Sodium, Entity Culling** - Optimizations to FPS, Ram usage, ect.

**CreativeCore, Drippy Loading Screen, FancyMenu, Forge Config API Port, Konkrete, MaLiLib, Melody, MidnightLib, Puzzles Lib, ukulib, YetAnotherConfigLib** - Dependencies. Some mods needs these to work.
